task_self_containment.text: Task 3 hardcodes detail data for one vehicle only ("VIN (1VUJB5B32F1234567), Current Mileage (187,643 mi)", checklist "Oil Change | 2026-01-15 | 15,000 mi", the 5 WO history rows "WO-2026-0515 ... WO-2026-0450"), yet its handler says "Load vehicle detail from URL param (`#/vehicle/:id`) -> populate header, checklist, notes, work orders". The isolated sub-agent has no VIN/mileage/last-service/checklist/notes data for the other 11 units (BX-2024-0512, CG-2023-1047, ... TR-2024-0298), so the route renders the wrong vehicle or blank for 11 of 12 targets.

Task 4 asks for "15 work order rows across 3 shops (5 per shop)" but spells out only 5 (WO-2026-0515 through WO-2026-0510) and then writes "[... shop filter changes which 5 are shown ...]". Worse, no row anywhere in Task 4 states which shop a WO belongs to, so the "Shop Filter Tabs" ("Downtown Bay", "North Warehouse", "East Terminal") have no data to filter on; the sub-agent must invent 10 rows and all 15 shop assignments.

Parts line items are named as content in two tasks but never given values: Task 4 "Line items table: columns [Part Name, Qty, Unit Cost, Total]" and Task 6 "Clicking work order link ... expand inline detail (WO breakdown: parts + labor)" — no part names, quantities or unit costs appear anywhere in the plan. Table columns without rows; the brief's "totals must sum from work order line items" cannot be demonstrated.
Task 2 drops the spec's "Clear filters link when filters applied" from the Vehicles filter controls; the task lists only "Type Filter:" label plus the five pills.

Task 6 self-contradicts on chart orientation: "Type: horizontal bar chart" followed by "X-axis: months (Jan 2025 through Jan 2026, 13 data points)" and "Y-axis: cost ($0 - $25,000)", which describes a vertical column chart.

build_order_coherence.text: Task 3's core actions forward-reference shared data that no earlier task creates. Task 1 defines only "Global state store (simple object): { currentPage, currentVehicleId, filters: { type, status, search }, ... }" — no vehicles, workOrders, lineItems or costs arrays — while Tasks 2/4/6 each hardcode their own rows as markup. So Task 3's "[Advance Status] -> ... update vehicle.status globally -> reload Vehicles page table + Work Orders queues" and "[Flag for Parts] -> ... update Parts & Costs totals" (and Task 4's "[Update Status] ... reflect on Vehicles page") mutate a model that does not exist, and Task 8 then asserts it: "[Advance Status] on Vehicle Detail updates vehicle globally (reflected in Vehicles table on reload)". The brief's central cross-page behaviour is unbuildable as sequenced.

Task 1 shell states "Nav items (6 total): Vehicles, Work Orders, Inspections, Parts & Costs, Settings, [Logout]" — a Logout entry that is not a page or route in the spec, padding the nav to a false count of 6.
Task 8 miscounts its own target: "Settings page: 3 form sections (Fleet, Shops, Notifications, Preferences)" lists four sections as three.

rationale: Page coverage is exactly right: 8 tasks = 1 shell (Task 1) + 6 page tasks (Task 2 Vehicles, Task 3 Vehicle Detail, Task 4 Work Orders, Task 5 Inspections, Task 6 Parts & Costs, Task 7 Settings) + 1 validation (Task 8), one page per task, none merged, numbering contiguous and wrapped in <tasks>. Self-containment is strong on Tasks 2, 5, 6 and 7 (full row sets, valued KPIs, 13 chart data points, every dropdown's options) but breaks on Task 3 (one vehicle's data for a 12-vehicle route), Task 4 (5 of 15 rows, no shop assignments) and the missing parts line items. Build order fails on the shared data model: Task 1 establishes tokens, classes, router and all six empty sections correctly, but never seeds the vehicle/work-order/cost arrays that Tasks 3, 4 and 6 mutate and read across pages, so the brief's status-propagation and cost-rollup requirements forward-reference state nothing creates.
strengths: Task count and mapping are exact: 1 shell + 6 page tasks + 1 validation, `## Task N:` headers contiguous 1-8, wrapped in <tasks>

Task 1 lays down every DS token verbatim from the spec (--accent: #0071e3, --status-awaiting-parts: #ff3b30, ...), the typography scale, and six empty `<section data-page="{id}" class="page">` elements including vehicle-detail, plus the hash routes map
Task 2 and Task 5 are fully buildable in isolation — all 12 vehicle rows and all 10 inspection rows are written out with badge colours and handler names
Task 6 gives valued KPI cards ($18,947 / +16% / vs. $16,320 last month), an 8-row cost table with a subtotal row, and 13 named chart data points with axis ranges and viewBox

Task 8 is plan-specific rather than generic: it checks 12 rows, 15 WOs, 10 inspections, 4 KPI cards, the 13-point chart, and the exact placeholder string "[Page {id} content — Task {N} fills this]" that Task 1 introduced
weaknesses: blocking: Task 3/4's cross-page state mutations ("update vehicle.status globally -> reload Vehicles page table + Work Orders queues", "[Flag for Parts] ... update Parts & Costs totals") forward-reference a shared data model Task 1 never creates — its store is only { currentPage, currentVehicleId, filters }, and each page task hardcodes its own markup
major: Task 3 supplies detail data (VIN 1VUJB5B32F1234567, 187,643 mi, checklist, notes, 5 WO history rows) for TRK-2026-0184 only, leaving the other 11 `#/vehicle/:id` targets with no data

major: Task 4 writes out 5 of its 15 work orders and elides the rest with "[... shop filter changes which 5 are shown ...]", and never assigns any WO to a shop, so the Downtown Bay / North Warehouse / East Terminal tabs have nothing to filter

major: parts line items are named as content in Task 4 ("Line items table: columns [Part Name, Qty, Unit Cost, Total]") and Task 6 but no part name, qty or unit cost is given anywhere, so the brief's cost roll-up cannot be shown
minor: Task 2 drops the spec's "Clear filters link when filters applied"
minor: Task 6 calls the trend chart a "horizontal bar chart" while describing months on X and cost on Y
minor: Task 1 counts "Nav items (6 total)" by including a [Logout] entry that is not a page or route
minor: Task 8 lists "3 form sections (Fleet, Shops, Notifications, Preferences)" — four items called three
